name: rfwizard
description: Unified browser-based RF coordination + wireless-mic monitoring suite: WSM/WWB file exchange, Ofcom PMSE licence import, and live receiver monitoring in one package.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "RFWIZARD_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfwizard/server" "npm run dev -w @rfwizard/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && RFWIZARD_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfwizard/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @rfwizard/web
scripts.dev:verify: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "RFWIZARD_DISABLE_MONITOR=1 RFWIZARD_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfwizard/server" "npm run dev -w @rfwizard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rfwizard/server && npm run build -w @rfwizard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rfwizard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rfwizard/server && npm run typecheck -w @rfwizard/web
